_media_slots: THE THIRD KIND OF EMPTY (Builder 1, 2026-09-21). A text "" renders nothing and is invisible; a number "" renders a zero; an IMAGE or VIDEO property whose default is "" renders a PANEL, and the panel IS the poster. A content check that counts only text and number properties clears that class truthfully and uselessly — mine cleared EmojiCard with '2 of 2 content properties carry a default' while its poster was a black rectangle over the speaker's face. Only the render caught it. So media slots are enumerated SEPARATELY and by TYPE, never folded into the copy check.

media_slots._finding: EmojiCard.still is the only media slot among the TWELVE MENU components — confirmed independently by Builder 1's falsy-default scan. But `renderable` is 27, and the other fifteen are transitions, zooms and overlays that all take `clip` (type video, defaultValue ""). ELEVEN render the literal string 'NO CLIP PROP' at frame 0 with default props, and ShutterFlashOverlay and LightLeakOverlay render 'NO CLIP'. That is EmojiCard's defect thirteen times over, found by widening the coverage leg rather than by looking at thirteen renders.

_queued_no_clip_poster._why_it_is_harder_than_EmojiCard: EmojiCard has content of its own — an emoji and a caption — so it can draw itself with no source. A transition has NO content of its own: it is a composite of two video layers, and with neither layer there is nothing of the component left to draw. A real poster for these means inventing furniture (two neutral plates mid-slide for SlideOver, a black ramp for DipToBlack), which is a design decision per component and not a mechanical fix.
